title: Temperature Converter
prompt:
Write a function `celsiusToFahrenheit(c)` that RETURNS the Fahrenheit equivalent — the formula is c * 9/5 + 32.

Then log `celsiusToFahrenheit(0)` (should print 32) and `celsiusToFahrenheit(100)` (should print 212).
boilerplate:
// celsiusToFahrenheit(c) returns the converted temperature


// log two conversions

tests.name: converts correctly
logs both examples
